text:
eli: onboarding saffron-32k-int4 run shows a repeating drop in token continuity around 11k/22k. quick smoke suggest it's tied to the prefetch encoder packing.

frank: can you paste minimal repro and a compact dump of the encoder outputs?

eli: repro snippet: ```bash
for L in 10900 11000 11264 11500; do
  curl -s -X POST https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"saffron-32k-int4","input":"X'"$L"'" ,"max_tokens":16, "prefetch_kv":true}' | jq -r .cache_stats
done
```
cache shows `prefetch_pack_overflow` toggling high at 11264.

ruth: pack format is 12-bit offset + 8-bit flags + 12-bit shard in our current shim? last refactor said 32-bit word with fields [offset:12 | flags:8 | shard:12]. if offset calc uses `floorf(scale * idx)` and scale is float16 LUT, boundaries can exceed 0xfff.

frank: dump (slice): `enc: 0xF7C3` -> offset=0xF7C (3964) > 0xfff -> overflow seen. expected wrap to 0x4 (4) for shard change.

eli: tried toggling `KV_SAFE_SATURATE=1` and overflow disappears. heavier test with stride>1 still clean.

ruth: short-term patch: clamp offset to 0xfff before pack. add unit test seeds hitting offsets [0xffc, 0xffd, 0xffe, 0xfff, 0x1000].

frank: agree. also add an integration in onboarding that compares top-k next-token continuity across longprefill (1000 probes) to detect stutters. put thresholds in baseline artifact.

opsbot: Created canary deploy plan saffron-32k-int4-satpatch (deploy id: plan-20260322-03).

eli: i'll run the full 32k sweep with the patch in canary tonight and post heatmaps. thanks. :white_check_mark:
